environment.methodology: Release published non-AOT WASM; production serializer, setter and component. Ten business properties plus ignored subscriber count. Setup excluded; completion includes synchronization, updateComplete and two animation frames. Optional equal forced-refresh warmup after cold initial binding; warmup outside measurements. Live managed heap includes the mounted component; not JS or peak memory. No builds during sampling.
